p: came out against us: Therefore aside from the commandment of the Lord, they had just cause to fight against him.
unwalled towns a great many: As villages and small towns.
women: Because this was God's appointment, therefore it may not be judged cruel.
bedstead was a bedstead of iron: The more terrible this giant was, the greater reason they had to glorify God for the victory.
this day: Meaning, when he wrote this history.
Jabbok: Which separates the Ammonites from the Amorites.
you at that time: That is, the Reubenites, Gadites, and half Manasseh, as in Nu 32:32.
LORD your God hath done unto: So that the victories did not come by your own wisdom, strength or multitude.
do according to thy works: He speaks according to the common and corrupt speech of those who attribute power to idols that only belongs to God.
mountain: He means Zion, where the Temple should be built, and God honoured.

lift up thine eyes westward: As before he saw by the spirits of prophecy the good mountain which was Zion: so here his eyes were lifted up above the order of nature to behold all the plentiful land of Canaan.
